integrity: Proof by an explicit complete acyclic face-poset matching and exact simplicial Lefschetz enumeration; two standalone Python 3 reproduction scripts plus outputs are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Only the Fano plane of order two is analyzed. Only rational homology, not integral homotopy or torsion, is asserted for the automorphism quotient. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible; independent review has not been performed.
title: The Heawood dominance complex is a six-sphere with orientation-preserving full symmetry
